bugs: dispatch returns the exception object instead of the response on error paths (base.py:107-109). Unreachable in practice: handle_exception below never re-raises, so DRF's own dispatch always receives a response and the outer except never fires. No wire effect; the port returns the mapped response and documents the quirk.

dispatch_quirk.description: except path computes response = self.handle_exception(exc) then returns exc, not response
dispatch_quirk.note: Unreachable: handle_exception (below) catches Exception and always returns a Response, never re-raising, so nothing escapes DRF dispatch into this except. The Rust port returns the mapped response.

filter_queryset.note: Loop applies each backend in order (base.py:53-56). With the D-01 defaults (empty filterset_fields/search_fields) both backends are identity; no license list endpoint passes a non-empty config, so the ported loop is documented identity.
